### Activity 5

Imagine that you are an English teacher. Write a short composition on what you will do for your students' effective learning of English.

#### Further Tasks

- Write a short composition describing your village/home town.
- Write a short composition narrating the experience of an interesting happening in your life.
- Write a short composition describing the cultural activities of your school this year.

### Activity 6

Write short compositions on

a Are you interested in students politics? Why/why not?

b The contributions of your parents in your life

c Print media versus electronic media

d The use of computers in Bangladesh

e What would you like to be after ten years

f Society and students

g A book/film you have enjoyed much

h My country my pride
